name: Asaoka Ayaka
source:
The protagonist's homeroom teacher.

She has 6 years of experience teaching in the school, but she still gets a little nervous when teaching the classes, although she always does her job with passion and dedication.

Ayaka has noticed that the protagonist is a victim of bullying and decides to give him her full attention, she has even decided to visit him personally at his house to cheer him up, little by little she develops a certain attraction for him.

Ayaka has had a couple of romances in the past but she has never kissed or had sexual relations with anyone, she believes that her virginity must be given to the person who will be her husband, this thought has made her a 35-year-old virgin.
